authority: Owner approved Iron Fist for regular Lucario, selected Toxic Technique for Mega Toxicroak, directed redistribution of 40 Special Attack points (30 Defense, 10 Special Defense), replaced Anticipation with Venomous Reflex, and instructed to lock the resulting package.

species.name: Mega Toxicroak
species.scope: species/form-wide; same package for player and bosses

abilities.name: Toxic Technique
abilities.effect: Punching and kicking moves gain Poison as an additional type for type effectiveness only, similar to Flying Press. No additional STAB or automatic poisoning. Already Poison-type moves do not gain duplicate Poison effectiveness. Ordinary type immunities remain in effect.

abilities.name: Venomous Reflex
abilities.effect: When struck by a damaging contact move, retaliates with a 40-base-power physical Poison-type attack. Activates once per turn, consumes no normal action, and cannot trigger another retaliatory attack.

preserve.roserade: unchanged; Venomous Bloom, Merciless, Flower Veil

mega_lucario_z.note: Preserve later owner-approved package; do not distribute its signature ability to regular Lucario.
